disposition_records.T08-ASYNC-XCTEST-DROPPED-FAILURES: Root investigation (V04/phaseC/fix4-root): on Swift 6.4 / Xcode 27, nonisolated async XCTest methods doing real awaited work dropped recorded assertion failures nondeterministically (33-48 of 48+; mid-sequence and tail losses) on byte-identical deterministic inputs. Sync and @MainActor methods recorded all failures. All 40 such methods are now @MainActor: 16 in V04 phase C (2179a19) and 24 here, plus assertion-bearing helpers. Repeated Debug ×4 and Release ×2 runs of the converted files: 31/31; no previously dropped failure surfaced. Forced-failure check: 8/8 recorded in 6/6 runs.

Inline pre-conversion fixtures prove RED without git history; history checks skip when objects are unavailable.
